argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Call me Ishmael. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world. It is a way I have of driving off the spleen and regulating the circulation. Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul; whenever I find myself involuntarily pausing before coffin warehouses, and bringing up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of me, that it requires a strong moral principle to prevent me from deliberately stepping into the street, and methodically knocking people's hats off—then, I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball. With a philosophical flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the ship. There is nothing surprising in this. If they but knew it, almost all men in their degree, some time or other, cherish very nearly the same feelings towards the ocean with me.
</passage>

response.text:
For attribution purposes, and with all appropriate caveats as to precision, an identifier construct along the lines of "Ishmael" may, at this juncture, be considered operationalized. At some point within a prior timeframe of unspecified duration—precise temporal alignment not being, in any material sense, a value-add—a condition characterized by minimal liquidity in the personal-finance vertical, coupled with an absence of shore-based stakeholder engagement opportunities, was identified. In response, a strategic pivot toward maritime deployment was, tentatively and without firm commitment, contemplated, with a view toward experiential exposure to the aquatic segment of the global landscape, at scale.

This may be characterized, to whatever extent such characterization holds up under scrutiny, as a recurring behavioral methodology leveraged for the mitigation of affective downturn and the general optimization of circulatory throughput. In circumstances where a perceptible grimness is observed to manifest facially; where a psychological climate approximating dampness, drizzle, and Novemberness is, however provisionally, self-diagnosed; where an involuntary tendency toward loitering in proximity to coffin-adjacent retail environments, and toward the informal shadowing of funeral processions, is noted; and, perhaps most saliently (though this too should not be overstated), where hypochondriacal tendencies achieve a degree of ascendancy such that only a robust framework of moral governance forestalls a deliberate ambulation into thoroughfares for the systematic, if not entirely well-defined, dislodging of pedestrian headwear—under such conditions, it is generally considered, without prejudice to alternative interpretations, that a maritime deployment initiative should be operationalized with minimal latency.

This may be understood, loosely speaking, as a functional alternative to firearm-and-projectile-based interventions. Where a Cato-type stakeholder might, with a certain philosophical flourish, self-terminate via bladed instrument, a comparable outcome is instead pursued through low-key vessel-embarkation. No particular element of surprise ought to be attached to this framework. Should relevant parties possess adequate self-awareness, it might be broadly acknowledged that a non-trivial proportion of the male population, at varying points across the lifecycle and to varying degrees, harbors sentiments toward the oceanic domain that are, in substance if not in form, largely synergistic with those outlined above.
